svg.text: Unified Editorial Platform: Editorial Strategy functional workflow (8 modules)

Schematic view of the primary use cases per module and how they hand off to each other. Source: GR v1, SIC v1, IA v1, TR v4, RD v1, OI v1. Contextual Workspaces and Workflow Coordination: requirement docs not available (TBD).
CONTEXTUAL WORKSPACES (CW) · TBD, requirement doc not available
Participant-facing layer: each module's output is presented in role-specific workspaces (presentation, reading/annotation, context).
Author intent, acceptable journals & routing authorisation
COI / sanctions / identity results → reviewer eligibility
Return to author: readiness fix (focused correction)
WORKFLOW COORDINATION (WC) · TBD, requirement doc not available
Orchestration layer owning scheduling, reminders, handoffs, SLAs, escalation and process execution (as assigned by the other docs).
STRUCTURED INFORMATION & CONTINUITY (SIC) · information foundation used by every module
▲ authoritative content, versions, change signals, provenance ▼ findings, decisions, history
GR, IA, TR, RD, WC, SIC

Numbers 1 to 4 show the typical order of a manuscript; activities may be combined, reordered or skipped by journal configuration (TR v4 §E). Use-case labels match the 'Use Case Title' rows in Editorial_Strategy_Use_Cases.xlsx.
